thread:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a new regional/zone dashboard feeding Console and SRE. Goals: latency by region/zone (p50/p95/p99), failover impact (traffic shifts + error delta), and traffic-split metrics by route/model/tier for rollout pages. Who owns metric additions?
Alex: Do we already have region labels on anything useful? I think request_count has region but latency is only per-host.
Sam: Latency is emitted per-host with instance_id/pool. We can add region/zone, but keeping instance_id will blow up cardinality. Two options: emit pre-aggregated per-region histograms from runtime, or add a scrape-time rollup.
Terri: SRE strongly prefers region+zone and no instance_id in high-card metrics. We need p99 stable for SLOs and failover diffs.
Maya: Console needs p99 by region for each route-model combo during rollouts. Prefers pre-aggregated metrics (lower cardinality) so dashboards are fast.
Sam: Plan proposal: runtime emits two new metrics: \n- r_inference_latency_bucket{region,zone,model,route,rollout_group,le}\n- r_request_total{region,zone,model,route,rollout_group}\nWe will sample models (top N by traffic) and map low-traffic models to "other" to cap cardinality.
Alex: Storage/retention note — keep 7d high-res (1m scrape) and 30d downsampled. Alerts will query high-res only.
Terri: For failover impact panels we need: traffic % by region, p99 delta (pre vs post shift), error rate spike, and traffic-split drift. Also rollouts UX wants a small sparkline per-region and a short text hint when p99 increases > X ms.
Sam: Example PromQL for regional p99 (5m sliding):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(r_inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, region, model, route))
```
Alex: For traffic splits:
```
sum(rate(r_request_total[5m])) by (region, model, rollout_group) / sum(rate(r_request_total[5m])) by (region) * 100
```
Maya: UX needs one extra label: `rollout_group` so we can visualize canary vs primary per-region. Good to hear that's included.
Sam: Implementation notes: will add aggregation in runtime agent to emit region-level histograms (no instance_id). We'll gate via feature flag `region-dashboard-metrics` and emit a metrics version tag.
InfraBot: deploy:metrics-pipeline queued for canary — will hit staging in ~45m. Use flag `region-dashboard-metrics` for staged rollout.
Terri: Alerts: create alert `RegionP99Regression` when p99 increases > 2x baseline AND absolute > 200ms for > 5m. Adam from paging rotation will review thresholds.
Alex: I'll build the initial Grafana dashboard with panels: "Traffic % by region", "p99 by region (route)", "p99 delta during failover", "Traffic-split drift" and share links.
Maya: Console integration: I'll add a per-route collapse showing region breakdown and a small warning banner when the RegionP99Regression alert fires.
Sam: Action items: implement runtime rollup + labels (Sam), pipeline changes & deploy (Infra), dashboard panels (Alex), alerts (Terri), Console UX hooks (Maya).
Terri: One more thing — please include a cost estimate for extra TSDB series in the PR, even if rough.
Maya: Thanks everyone — ping me if you need design bits. :thumbsup:
Alex: sounds good. Will post dashboard link once initial panels are up.
Sam: will open PR with metric docs and example queries.
Maya: resolved? :eyes:
Terri: :+1:
